title: Greet everyone in a list
objective: Call a function with each item of a list inside a loop, and print what it returns.

body.text: A loop and a function work well together. repeat for each gives you one item at a time, and you can pass that item to a function. The function's answer is printed each time round the loop.

body.title: Greet each name
body.code:
function greeting
    takes text called name
    returns text
    gives back "Hello, {name}!"

make names equal to a list of "Kim", "Lee"
repeat for each n in names
    say greeting n

body.prompt: The program greets only Ada, but the list also holds Ben. Make it greet Ada and then Ben.
body.starter:
function greeting
    takes text called name
    returns text
    gives back "Hello, {name}!"

make names equal to a list of "Ada", "Ben"
say greeting "Ada"
body.solution:
function greeting
    takes text called name
    returns text
    gives back "Hello, {name}!"

make names equal to a list of "Ada", "Ben"
repeat for each n in names
    say greeting n

checks.description: It prints Hello, Ada! and then Hello, Ben!
